'''Enmonst Rclub''' was an establishment in a seedy part of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], situated between [[Sleeping Rose/Legends|Sleeping Rose]] and [[The Hole/Legends|The Hole]]. A run-down neon sign spelled out the name.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] stayed in an apartment on the same block, while planning the [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|Mission to the Jedi Temple]].
